This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on patients' lives through direct care, with a competitive compensation structure based on a per-visit model.

As a PTA, you will work collaboratively to implement individualized treatment plans, helping patients regain mobility and improve their quality of life. This position emphasizes patient-centered care and offers flexibility in scheduling, allowing for a work-life balance.

If you are a compassionate and skilled PTA looking for a rewarding opportunity to provide high-quality therapy services, we encourage you to apply. Join a team committed to excellence and patient well-being.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program
Current Alabama state licensure as a Physical Therapist Assistant
Basic Life Support (BLS) or CPR certification
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
Ability to work independently and manage a caseload effectively
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is set at $35 per visit, offering a clear and competitive pay structure for your services.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join a dynamic team providing essential therapy services in the Alpine, AL area. This role offers the unique opportunity to deliver patient-centered care directly in the comfort of their homes, making a tangible difference in their daily lives and recovery journeys.

As a COTA, you will work collaboratively to implement individualized treatment plans, assist patients in regaining independence, and contribute to their overall well-being. This position is ideal for a professional who thrives on autonomy and enjoys the flexibility of a per-visit compensation model. We are actively scheduling interviews Monday through Friday from 1 PM to 7 PM, with weekend availability as needed, to accommodate your schedule and expedite the hiring process.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Occupational Therapy Assistant program
Current Alabama COTA licensure or eligibility
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
Ability to travel to patient homes within the service area
Strong communication and documentation skills

description:

MDS 3.0 certification (e.g., RAC-CT)
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator, with multi-facility or regional experience preferred
Thorough knowledge of federal and state regulations pertaining to MDS and resident assessment
Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills
